boundary_conditions: u(0) = riblet_effectiveness * 0.2 * riblet_spacing * (1 - exp(-2 * riblet_height / riblet_spacing)) / equivalent_laminar_gap * du_dy(0)

parameters.name: equivalent_laminar_gap
parameters.justification: H = nu*U/u_tau^2 reproducing the 100 Pa smooth-wall shear

parameters.name: riblet_effectiveness
parameters.justification: Protrusion-height difference retained after averaging s+ over hull speed and position, trapezoidal (not blade) profile and tip rounding; gives effective dU+ about 1.0
